articles.title: It’s up to Congress to clean up the country’s prediction-market mess
articles.summary: Congress is finally acknowledging that prediction markets need actual rules instead of the legal gray zone they've been operating in. If they actually legislate this space, we're either getting a legitimacy boost that transforms these markets into real price-discovery engines, or we're getting regulations so restrictive that half the interesting bets disappear.

articles.title: How Louisiana became a battleground in the national fight over prediction markets
articles.summary: Louisiana's regulatory crackdown on prediction markets is forcing the industry to fight on unfamiliar legal ground, turning a single state into a test case for broader restrictions. If Louisiana succeeds in boxing out the platforms, it'll give other states a roadmap to follow, and suddenly your favorite markets could vanish overnight.

articles.title: In defense of prediction markets
articles.summary: Prediction markets are probably getting roasted somewhere, and somebody's finally throwing elbows back. If the defense lands, it matters because regulatory skeptics and media critics are the actual threat to market adoption, not the markets themselves.

articles.title: Experts release early Oregon vs. Washington predictions, best bets for Saturday’s rivalry game
articles.summary: The Oregon Ducks and Washington Huskies face off Saturday with early expert picks and wagering recommendations already circulating ahead of the rivalry matchup. This game matters because sharp bettors move prediction markets fast, and early expert consensus often signals where the smart money's already flowing.

articles.title: Opinion | Kalshi’s sports bets are everywhere. They’re also likely illegal.
articles.summary: Kalshi, the prediction markets platform, is getting slapped with legal pushback over sports betting offerings that regulators say violate federal law. If the feds actually enforce this, it could crater the entire regulatory gray zone that lets prediction markets operate in the US.

articles.title: Will Aaron Rodgers Retire? Next Team Odds on Kalshi & Polymarket (Nov 2026)
articles.summary: Aaron Rodgers' retirement status and next destination are trading on Kalshi and Polymarket, with odds reflecting the quarterback's perpetual unpredictability and the NFL offseason chaos machine. Market liquidity on player movement bets has exploded since legal prediction markets launched, so these contracts could actually move real money instead of just fueling bar arguments.

articles.title: Analysis: Kalshi Largely Accurate On Trump Mention Markets
articles.summary: Kalshi's Trump mention markets apparently nailed their predictions, suggesting their modeling on political rhetoric actually works. That's the kind of track record that makes prediction markets look less like a casino and more like a tool worth taking seriously.

articles.title: Spurs Extending Lead in Kalshi NBA Finals Market
articles.summary: The San Antonio Spurs are pulling ahead in Kalshi's NBA Finals prediction market, suggesting smart money is increasingly bullish on their championship odds. If the Spurs keep gaining ground, it could signal a sharp shift away from conventional favorites, which means contrarian bettors who loaded up early stand to print real money.

articles.title: Is Tickmill Launching Prediction Markets?
articles.summary: Tickmill, a retail forex and CFD broker, is apparently considering entry into the prediction markets space. If they launch, they're bringing an established brokerage infrastructure and retail customer base into a market that's been fragmented between crypto platforms and traditional betting sites.

articles.title: Most Polymarket users lost money betting on the U.S. midterms, report finds
articles.summary: A new report shows that most Polymarket participants got worked on the 2022 midterms, losing money despite having access to real-time crowd wisdom. It's a sobering reminder that prediction markets reward accuracy and information edge, not mere participation, which should terrify anyone planning to yolo their rent into the next election cycle.

articles.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
articles.summary: OpenAI is now expected to go public sometime later in 2027 instead of earlier in the year, according to prediction market data. If true, it delays when early bettors can cash out their positions and shifts the timeline for one of tech's most anticipated IPOs by several months.

articles.title: Gold drops below $3,500; prediction markets price moderate year-end targets
articles.summary: Gold just fell below $3,500 for the first time in weeks, and traders are now betting the yellow metal won't see a dramatic year-end rally. That matters because prediction market prices typically front-run mainstream sentiment, so if money's flowing into "gold stays flat" bets, it signals institutional players see limited upside before the calendar flips.
